reason: User requested fresh repeats to assess machine-load variation. Selected before these rerun outcomes.
second_pass: reverse case order and starting arm
monitor: 1-second host CPU/load and external process CPU deltas; before/after thermal, swap and vm snapshots
rejection_rule: Gate before timing only; keep and report every completed sample regardless of outcome or measured load.
production_startup: Normal --nodetach; no test mode or runtime UID pinning
limitations: External CPU from surviving process deltas can miss processes that exit within a sampling interval.
No CPU affinity, frequency lock, or exclusive machine access.
Independent startups can change index UID and shared-cache shard routing.
